basic_info.main_problem: 作为喜欢跑车的Female孩，我觉得自己永远not可能像Male那样了解跑车，因而产生自卑与Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of inferiority are affecting my self-esteem and my enjoyment of hobbies.
growth_experiences: 约两年前开始对跑车产生兴趣；认为社会刻板印象与汽车行业Female代表的缺乏是问题的主要原因，这一认知逐步Reinforcement为“Female生not可能像Male生那样懂车”，并加重Self-doubt。
与Male同伴讨论赛车话题时常感到被轻视和被评判；曾在在线论坛中有被他人认可的积极讨论，但这些正面时刻被负面体验所遮蔽。

core_beliefs: 我是Female生，所以在跑车知识上永远not如Male。

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能像他们一样侃侃而谈或展现足够知识，就会被轻视，证明Female生天生not如Male生懂车。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Researching extensively in advance to build knowledge reserves
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得我not懂车、在看not起我。

special_situations.event: Car-related topics coming up in any social situation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果话题涉及汽车而我not能表现得很懂，就会被看not起并证实自己not如人。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Joins online forums and does further research in an attempt to boost confidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次又会被看not起，我会显得很外行。

special_situations.event: 注意到车圈与汽车行业中Female代表较少
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果Female在这个领域很少见，就说明Female生not可能达到与Male生同等的知识水平。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用“Female稀少”作为证据驱动自己持续学习来证明价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Female生在这里很少，所以我也not可能像他们一样懂。

special_situations.event: Has received recognition from others for his views in online forums
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not是所有情况下都得到认可，那些正面反馈就not算数。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores moments of being recognized; focuses more on negative experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些认可not代表什么，仍然说明I am not good enough。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be treated equally, recognized as a capable sports car enthusiast.
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因性do not被轻视或negate，担心被评判为外行。
defense_goal: Gains a sense of security through rational learning and preparation; reduces exposure and sharing in interpersonal settings to avoid being devalued.

object_relations.self_representation: not被认可的外行、容易被轻视的Female孩
Capable enthusiast who can contribute ideas
object_relations.object_representation: Online community members who offer affirmation and acceptance

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当Male同伴自信地讨论汽车、展现熟悉度时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方的自信解读为对自己的贬低与轻视（认为他们在看not起自己）。
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气平和、探索式Questioning；先标注和反映对被轻视的感受，再共同检视证据与替代解释，避免直接指责。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to do reality testing or discuss objective facts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Uses piling up rational-level information to isolate from emotions, believing 'as long as I learn enough I will be safe'.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopts gentle, concrete emotion-focused language; invites them to describe present bodily and emotional experience, balancing fact-checking with emotional connection.
